SESSION	create temporary view t1(c1, c2) as values (0, 1), (1, 2)
SESSION	create temporary view t2(c1, c2) as values (0, 2), (0, 3)
SESSION	create temporary view t3(c1, c2) as values (0, 3), (1, 4), (2, 5)
